Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning estate tax deductions for certain property held by qualified family-owned businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to estate tax deductions for certain property heldby qualified familyowned businesses; and adding a new section tochapter 83.100 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 83.100 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of determining the Washington taxable estate, adeduction is allowed from the federal taxable estate for the value ofqualified familyowned business interests of the decedent. Thisdeduction applies only if the qualified familyowned business interestis acquired by any qualified heir from, or passed to any qualified heirfrom, the decedent, within the meaning of RCW 83.100.046(2) and thedecedent was at the time of his or her death a citizen or resident ofthe United States. Only property in the federal taxable estate and notdeductible under RCW 83.100.046 may be deducted under this section.For the purposes of determining the deduction amount, the value ofproperty is its value as used to determine the value of the grossestate. For purposes of this section, the following definitions apply: p. 1 SB 6095 (1) "Qualified familyowned business interest" has the same meaningas in 26 U.S.C. Sec. 2057(e) of the federal internal revenue code as itexists on January 1, 2003. (2) "Qualified heir" has the same meaning as in 26 U.S.C. Sec.2057(i) of the federal internal revenue code as it exists on January 1,2003.
